purpose: Teach: 装丁/通信員/前倒し/相殺/概説/差し引い/値下がり/後ろ向き

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、博士論文の装丁にも気を配れ
lines.en: Ren — pay attention to the binding quality of your dissertation as well.
lines.style: Direct but not unkind. Measured pace. The tone of someone accustomed to being listened to. A teacher offering pragmatic counsel.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。学会通信員から最新情報を頂きました
lines.en: Yes. I received the latest information from the conference liaison.
lines.style: Respectful nod in the voice. Alert, earnest. Quick to show he's acted on feedback. A student genuinely trying to impress.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、論文提出を前倒しで進めろ
lines.en: Ren — move up your paper submission timeline.
lines.style: Clipped, efficient. No wasted words. The cadence of a directive, not a suggestion. Warm underneath but unmistakably an order.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究費を相殺する仕組みを検討しております
lines.en: Yes. I'm currently examining the mechanism for offsetting the research budget costs.
lines.style: Careful, almost rehearsed. He's thought this through. Slightly faster than normal, eager to show competence. A touch nervous underneath.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、論文の冒頭に研究の概説を入れろ
lines.en: Ren — include an overview of your research in the opening of your paper.
lines.style: Even tone, patient. The rhythm of a mentor who has given this advice before and means it. A slight pause before the directive, letting it settle.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究費から経費を差し引いた残額を確認しました
lines.en: Yes. I've confirmed the remaining balance after deducting expenses from the research fund.
lines.style: Quiet confidence. He's done the math, checked his work. Speaking plainly without apology. The voice of someone who has completed a task thoroughly.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究機材の値下がり時に購入しろ
lines.en: Ren — purchase the research equipment when prices drop.
lines.style: Swift, pragmatic instruction. No elaboration needed. The tone of someone who expects the listener to understand the wisdom without explanation.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。後ろ向きな実験結果も論文で扱います
lines.en: Yes. I intend to address the negative experimental results in the paper as well.
lines.style: Steady conclusion. A slight deepening of resolve. He's committing to honesty in his work. The finality of someone making a principled decision.
